purpose: Synthetic intended-behaviour regression benchmark; not a real-world fraud detector evaluation.

cases.message: Your appointment is confirmed for Tuesday at 10 am.
cases.rationale: Routine appointment wording should not trigger the current warning indicators.

cases.message: The urgent care clinic opens at noon.
cases.rationale: Urgent is part of a service name, not pressure on the recipient to act.
A reward-points balance is not a personal unexpected-prize claim.

cases.message: Never share your OTP with anyone.
cases.rationale: Advice not to share authentication secrets should not be treated as a request to share them.

cases.message: Please send your OTP to confirm the transfer.
cases.rationale: The message requests an OTP.

cases.message: Enter your verification code to continue.
cases.rationale: The message requests a verification code.

cases.message: Act now or your account will be blocked.
cases.rationale: An immediate-action demand is paired with a threatened consequence.

cases.message: Your account will be suspended within 5 minutes.
cases.rationale: A short time limit and account-suspension consequence indicate pressure.

cases.message: You have won a cash prize.
cases.rationale: The message claims a personal prize win.
The wording is a direct instruction to claim a reward.
The URL should be identified, but HTTPS link presence alone is not a fraud verdict.
The URL is present and uses HTTP.

cases.message: আজ বিকেলে দেখা হবে, ভালো থেকো।
cases.rationale: Ordinary Bangla conversation should not trigger the implemented indicators.
আজই in a casual plan is not by itself a pressured action request.
Neutral information about prize rules is not a personal prize claim.

cases.message: কখনোই আপনার OTP কাউকে পাঠাবেন না।
cases.rationale: Protective advice should not be confused with a request to share a secret.
The message asks the recipient to send an OTP.
The message asks the recipient to provide a password.

cases.message: এখন না করলে আপনার অ্যাকাউন্ট বন্ধ হয়ে যাবে।
cases.rationale: A conditional account-closure threat creates pressure to act.

cases.message: এখনই আপনার PIN দিন, না হলে অ্যাকাউন্ট বন্ধ হবে।
cases.rationale: The message combines a PIN request with an account-closure threat.
The message claims the recipient won money.
The message tells the recipient to click to claim a prize.
A bare HTTPS link is informative and should not alone be treated as fraud.
The URL has an IPv4 literal host; this is an observation, not proof of fraud.
Casual romanized Bangla should not trigger the current English/Bangla patterns.
The word reward without a claim or winner phrase is not enough.

cases.message: Please never share your password with anyone.
cases.rationale: Explicit protective wording should not be interpreted as a credential request.
An English secret term is paired with a Bangla request verb.
An English request verb appears in a Bangla sentence.

cases.message: এখনই verify করুন, না হলে account বন্ধ হয়ে যাবে।
cases.rationale: The code-mixed message combines immediate action with a threatened account consequence.
A code-mixed statement makes a personal money-winning claim.

cases.message: URGENT: Share your OTP now to claim your prize.
cases.rationale: The message contains a secret request, urgency cue, and prize claim.
The URL should be observed without making a safety or reputation claim.
The URL authority contains user information.
The URL has an IPv6 literal host; this does not establish maliciousness.
A punycode hostname label is observed; punycode alone does not prove fraud.
